scope: KQS v3 learning-data readiness, explicit consent and revocation, protected backend deployment configuration. No model fit on user data and no automatic trading behavior.
reused_boundaries: D-20/D-26 consumed holdout and no re-selection
D-28/D-44 engine records separate from user manual records
EINT-009 immutable manifests and one-time holdout
EINT-013 v3 engine-time feature provenance and legacy v2 archive-only policy

implementation.quality_gate: read-only class counts, date count/span/concentration, split diversity, 20-day labels and provenance; invalid candidate data blocks new v3 freeze
implementation.consent: default denied; explicit KQS_LEARNING_DATA_ONLY acknowledgement; immutable grant/revoke events; revocation blocks later v3 export, new freeze, holdout, experiment recording and offline runner use
implementation.immutable_history: Existing manifests, holdout openings and experiments are retained for audit and never rewritten by consent revocation.
implementation.deployment: main deployment requires callable KQS CI before image build; preflight validates existing Compose identity, private environment file and read-only KQS state mount; deployment uploads only compose definition, restarts only backend, preserves environment/state/services, and rolls back an unhealthy backend image.
